# INHGA regression fixtures

These original public bulletin images are used to verify extraction against
independently transcribed water-level values, dates, units and negative signs.

- `6-1.jpg`: https://www.hidro.ro/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/6-1.jpg
  (bulletin dated 2 November 2026).
- `inhga-2026-11-01.jpg`: https://www.hidro.ro/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/6.jpg
  (bulletin dated 1 November 2026).

Source: Institutul Național de Hidrologie și Gospodărire a Apelor, https://www.hidro.ro/.
Fixtures are test inputs only; production always obtains the current dated bulletin.
